import urllib.request
import json

url = "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O76075.json"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python/urllib'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
    d = json.loads(response.read().decode())

seq_obj = d.get('sequence', {})
print("UniProt sequence object:", seq_obj)
print("Len of seq value:", len(seq_obj.get('value', '')))

# Check features
features = d.get('features', [])
max_end = 0
for f in features:
    loc = f.get('location', {})
    end = loc.get('end', {}).get('value')
    if end and end > max_end:
        max_end = end
print("Max feature end coordinate:", max_end)

# Check isoforms
for comment in d.get('comments', []):
    if comment.get('commentType') == 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS':
        print("Alternative products:", json.dumps(comment, indent=2))
